This average value is slightly higher than the reference range for premenopausal women (0.1-0.55 ng/mL). However, some readers of this site have reported that suppression was insufficient (1.68 ng/mL) even with the combination of MPA 5-10 mg + 4 mg of estradiol valerate.
MtFでは、非注射のエストラジオールを中等量で併用すると、テストステロンは大きく: In MtF, when combined with moderate doses of non-injectable estradiol, testosterone levels drop significantly, but they often remain above the normal range for women. MtF may require higher doses (100 to 300 mg, sometimes 400 mg per day) to block residual androgens, whereas cisgender women often use 50 to 200 mg per day to treat androgen-related symptoms. A general term for various physical conditions that are born with chromosomes, gonads, hormones, body structure, etc. that do not completely fit into the definition of a typical male or female. In medicine, it is also called ``Disorders of Sexual Development'' (DSD), or ``different sexual development of the body.'' We're talking about physical characteristics, which are separate from gender identity and sexual orientation. Although it does not mean a "third gender," it does not mean that it can be pinned down to a specific gender, and gender identities vary from person to person (male, female, non-binary, etc.; there are also transgender people). Although it is a different concept from transgender, there are people who overlap and are considered part of LGBTQIA+.
